description: This file defines a Perl class 'Coocook::View::Email::TT' which extends Catalyst::View::TT. It customizes the render method to log email sending details and sets configuration options for TT templates used in email rendering within the Coocook application.

classes.name: Coocook::View::Email::TT
classes.description: A helper view class for rendering TT templates in emails, extending Catalyst::View::TT with custom render behavior and configuration.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Overrides the default render method to add logging of email recipient and subject before returning the rendered output.
